archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Single-target precision and sustained aim buildup. Dexterity-focused ranged damage that rewards committing to one target turn after turn, with penetration, pinpoint, and aim-spending payoffs that grow stronger the longer focus is maintained.

Major: Ranged attack with increased accuracy and critical chance at cost of speed (Archer)
Ranged attack that causes damage weakness on critical (Archer)
Ranged attack that uses aim to provide penetration (Archer)
Ranged attack that causes defense weakness on critical (Archer)
Ranged attack that uses aim to cause delay (Archer)
Unerring ranged attack versus flanked target (Archer)
Ranged attack with a chance to disrupt (Archer)
Ranged attack that always targets the back row (Archer)
Ranged attack that strikes twice with lower accuracy (Archer)
Prepared ranged attack that determines target on preparation.  Maintains the same target until enemy dies (Archer)
Ranged attack that consumes all aim to deal damage based on aim used (Archer)
Ranged attack that uses aim to cause speed weakness (Archer)
Ranged attack that deals more damage the longer battle has lasted (Archer)
Next attack against all enemies is a guaranteed hit (Archer)
Prepared ranged attack with pinpoint that determines its target on preparation (Archer)
Ranged attack that also makes a second attack against a random enemy (Archer)
Unerring ranged attack that ignores aversion and compel (Archer)
Move: Increases aim but archer has lowered dodge until next turn (Archer)
Grants the archer damage shield and aim.  Must be used as final action (Archer)
Gain enhanced critical chance and critical damage with next attack.  Amplified.  Resets with attack (Archer)
Prepared ability.  Next attack is treated as if it had distance (Archer)
If archer is attacked before next turn with ranged, counter attack and reset timer (Archer)
Prepared ranged attack that determines its target on preparation (Archer)

Grants an ally enhanced accuracy and pinpoint for their next attack. That attack must target the Archer’s current aim target. If the aim target is no longer available when the ally acts, the ally retains the accuracy and pinpoint bonus without the targeting restriction. (Archer)
Lowers the accuracy of all enemies until the Archer’s next turn. Deals no damage. Does not reset aim. (Archer)
Omega. Enhances the Archer’s next attack’s damage and accuracy. Can be used multiple times in succession, each use stacks the bonus further. Resets when the Archer makes an attack. (Archer)
Ranged attack. Requires the archer is alone. (Archer)
Minor: Enhances one ally’s accuracy until archer’s next turn (Archer)
Prepared disruption that determines its target on preparation (Archer)
If targeted by area attack before next turn, reduce damage and delay self (Archer)
Quicken self for each prepared vow ability (Archer)
Prepared ability that generates aim and lowers target dodge (Archer)
Enhances unit’s dodge until its next turn (Archer)
Sacrifice focus to make next attack unerring (Archer)
Transfers the Archer’s current aim to a new chosen target. The new target becomes the active aim target. Aim is transferred at 75% of its current value, with 25% lost in the transition. (Archer)
Applies the flanked condition to the current aim target. Requires aim. (Archer)

capstone.name: Ranged Persistence:  Whenever the Archer misses with a ranged attack, they have increased accuracy with the next ranged attack they make.  This accuracy bonus stacks until the archer hits with an attack.

passives: Ranged damage increases the damage of any ranged ability.
Penetration increases the amount of armor ignored by penetrate abilities.  If penetration exceeds 100%, the damage is increased by the left-over percentage.
Accuracy increases the chance for the unit to hit with ranged and melee attacks.
Pinpoint increases the value of pinpoint damage and effects
Alone damage increases the damage of the unit when it is the last unit left alive.
Critical chance increases the chance for attacks of the unit to be critical hits.
Initial accuracy increases the chance to hit for the unit’s first action of each wave.
Distant damage increases the damage of any ability targeting enemies in the back row.  Distant abilities gain increased bonus.
Dodge increases the chance for a unit to avoid attacks.
Speed increases how often a unit gets to act.
Area dodge increases the chance for the unit to dodge abilities that target all, rows, and columns.
Dexterity mastery increases the adjusted value of dexterity by a percentage amount.  Mastery abilities do not affect acquisition of abilities.
Ranged critical chance increases the chance for the unit to deal critical hits with ranged attacks.
Ranged accuracy increases the chance for the unit to hit with ranged attacks.
Disruption power increases the value of any disrupt effect used by the unit.
Solitary power increases the damage and healing of single-target abilities used by the unit.
Ignore counter gives the unit a chance to ignore the effects of any counter attack.
Air adds increases air damage which is added to attacks.
Ignore disarm gives the unit a chance to ignore any disarm effect caused on them.
Avoid parry reduces the chance for attacks from the unit to be parried.
Justice increases the value of justice effects, causing more damage and greater effects based on the difference between the user and target’s health.

barbarian.name: Barbarian
barbarian.description: High-risk melee burst powered by taking damage. Strength-focused raw output that deliberately weaponizes self-harm to generate rage, with berserk states that amplify damage at the cost of control and a deferred-damage capstone that turns invulnerability into a ticking clock.

Major: Melee attack with a clobbering modification. (Barbarian)
Melee attack requiring rage, dealing extra damage based on current rage. (Barbarian)
Melee attack with lower accuracy but greater critical damage. (Barbarian)
Melee attack that damages the Barbarian as well, generating extra Anguish. (Barbarian)
Melee attack consuming rage. Note: Initially deals more damage than Rage Cleaver, but with enough rage, Rage Cleaver can surpass it. (Barbarian)
Melee attack with bloodlust targeting a random enemy. Can be used while Berserk. (Barbarian)
Melee attack requiring the Barbarian to be suffering from Berserk. (Barbarian)
Melee attack versus single target that damages enemies adjacent to the target against combined defense of primary and secondary target. (Barbarian)
Melee attack with guaranteed critical. Does not trigger critical effects other than critical damage. (Barbarian)
Two random melee attacks with lower accuracy. (Barbarian)
Melee attack that causes exhausted on target. (Barbarian)
Melee attack enhanced by quickens used since last turn. (Barbarian)
Melee attack that maximizes damage on critical. (Barbarian)
Melee attack with clobbering that requires momentum. (Barbarian)
Melee attack with the ruthless modifier that damages the Barbarian. (Barbarian)
Large weapon melee attack. Overkill damage generates Anguish. (Barbarian)
Melee attack requiring the Barbarian to be compelled. (Barbarian)
Melee attack that enhances damage based on overkill. (Barbarian)
Melee attack with increased critical chance and damage, requiring the Barbarian to be endangered. (Barbarian)
High damage attack that exhausts the Barbarian. (Barbarian)
Clobbering melee attack that stuns the target. (Barbarian)
Melee attack that stuns all enemies based on overkill. (Barbarian)
Melee attack that is always countered. (Barbarian)
Dual-wield melee attack with reaping. Benefits both hits and misses. (Barbarian)
Move: Grants a damage shield at the cost of health, generating extra Anguish. (Barbarian)
Single target melee attack useable during Wrath forms. (Barbarian)
Purges countdowns from the Barbarian with a weak heal. Requires countdown. Generates Anguish based on countdown value. (Barbarian)
Earth melee damage following a critical. Consumes Anguish. (Barbarian)
Fire melee damage following a critical. Backbiting. (Barbarian)
Provokes an enemy, forcing the next active enemy to attack the Barbarian. Generates Anguish on the enemy's attack. (Barbarian)
Air melee damage following a critical. Costs mana. (Barbarian)
Grants the next attack a bonus based on current Warpaint. (Barbarian)
Water melee damage following a critical. Requires Berserk. (Barbarian)
Minor: The Barbarian gains increased damage while in this Wrath. When this Wrath ends, the Barbarian is tired. (Barbarian)
Spend Anguish to gain the Berserk condition. (Barbarian)
Enhances critical damage of one ally for their next turn. (Barbarian)
Generates Anguish and enhances damage. Requires the Barbarian to be endangered. (Barbarian)
Follows a kill by causing frightened on a single enemy. (Barbarian)
Raises maximum damage while lowering minimum damage. Toggled. (Barbarian)
Ends Wrath form, conserving any remaining Anguish. Reduces duration of post-Wrath consequences. (Barbarian)
The Barbarian gains further increased damage and critical damage while in this Wrath. When this Wrath ends, the Barbarian is exhausted. (Barbarian)
Applies the next Warpaint to a chosen ally as well. (Barbarian)
Increased damage until end of turn at cost of health. Generates Anguish. (Barbarian)
Grants immunity to frightened and enhanced affliction resistance. (Barbarian)

capstone.name: Berserk Fortitude:  While the Barbarian is berserk, a percentage of all damage taken is delayed until the end of the berserk condition.  When the Barbarian loses the berserk condition, all of this damage is taken at once with no method to reduce or ignore it.

bard.name: Bard
bard.description: Team-wide buffing and debuffing through sustained song. Wisdom-focused support that maintains audience-based chord and dischord effects across multiple characters simultaneously, rewarding careful composition of who is listening and what condition is most valuable at any moment.

Major: Refrain that damages all enemies in the audience (Bard)
Ranged note that deals damage and causes unlucky accuracy (Bard)
Healing note that also quickens the target (Bard)
Heal that also provides regeneration to the target (Bard)
Ranged note that deals damage with the shattering modification (Bard)
Grant air retaliation and enhance dodge of team.  Delay all enemies (Bard)
Ranged note that damages two random enemies (Bard)
Ranged attack that grants lucky to all allies that attack target before next turn (Bard)
Refrain that heals all allies in the audience (Bard)
Ranged attack with penetration that lowers defense on critical (Bard)
Water magic attack that delays all enemies (Bard)
Air magic attack that enhances accuracy of all allies (Bard)
Raises a fallen ally. Must be fully channeled to succeed. More mana-efficient than other resurrections. (Bard)
Refrain that disenchants all enemies in the audience. (Bard)
Earth magic attack that reduces the damage of the next attack against each ally. (Bard)
Fire magic attack that grants all allies fire retaliation. (Bard)
Grants a lucky enchantment to all allies for approximately 3 turns. (Bard)
Applies a speed enhancement to all allies for approximately 3 turns. (Bard)
Applies damage, accuracy, and critical chance enhancements to a single ally for approximately 4 turns. All three trigger Resounding Performance. (Bard)
Prepared ability. Each ally reflects a flat percentage of damage taken back to the attacker. Lasts until the Bard's next turn. (Bard)
Four randomly targeting water magic attacks. After all four resolve, applies an accuracy reduction debuff to all enemies as an area effect. (Bard)
Move: Purges unit of condition, adds to audience (Bard)
Dischord that causes enemies in audience to bleed (Bard)
Enhance target accuracy for a period (Bard)
Next time unit misses, it becomes a critical instead (Bard)
Enhance target damage for a period (Bard)
Enhance target defense for a period (Bard)
Delay target enemy and add it to the audience (Bard)
Enhance target dodge for a period (Bard)
Heal target ally and delay random enemy (Bard)
Enhance target elemental resistance for a period (Bard)
Heal target ally.  Can be sustained from turn to turn (Bard)
Channeled ability that cleanses a target ally of afflictions. Must complete the full channel. (Bard)
Minor: Chord that causes allies in audience to regenerate (Bard)
Chord that enhances speed of allies in audience (Bard)
Grants all allies enhanced air resistance if the bard’s air resistance is higher, requires preparation (Bard)
Chord that enhances status resistance of allies in audience (Bard)
Chord that enhances elemental resistance of allies in audience (Bard)
Dischord that weakens damage of enemies in audience (Bard)
On next miss, target ally rerolls attack with lucky bonuses (Bard)
Enhances one ally's counter chance until end of their turn. Enhancement condition — triggers Resounding Performance. (Bard)
Enhances one ally's elemental resistance until end of their turn. Enhancement condition — triggers Resounding Performance. (Bard)

capstone.name: Resounding Performance
capstone.text: When the Bard applies an enhancement condition, it has a chance to critical based on spell critical chance. A critical enhancement has a greater effect than normal.

binder.name: Binder
binder.description: Companion summoning and alignment management. Wisdom-focused control that pushes along an Eros/Thanatos scale to unlock and empower summoned allies, with threshold-crossing bursts that reset alignment and punish enemies when commitment to one side runs too deep.

Major: Summons a light-based drake companion. Available regardless of alignment. (Binder)
Summons a dark-based imp companion. Available regardless of alignment. (Binder)
Light magic attack that generates Eros. Damage and cost increase with Eros scale position. (Binder)
Heals and quickens target. Greater effect on companions. (Binder)
Dark magic attack that generates Thanatos. Damage and cost increase with Thanatos scale position. (Binder)
Magic earth attack that enhances own defense if Eros-aligned and lowers target damage if Thanatos-aligned. Enhanced by alignment. (Binder)
Deals light damage to all enemies. Grants the Binder regeneration and light add to all attacks for the rest of battle. Requires max Eros. Does not change scale position. (Binder)
Summons a dark-based hellhound companion. Requires Thanatos side of scale. (Binder)
Summons an unaligned mephit companion. Consumes the higher of Eros or Thanatos resource. Does not affect scale position. Binder exclusive. (Binder)
Summons a light-based unicorn companion. Requires Eros side of scale. (Binder)
Light magic attack that heals the Binder. Healing increases with Eros scale position. Cost increases with Eros scale position. (Binder)
Dark magic attack that deals increased damage. Damage increases with Thanatos scale position. Cost increases with Thanatos scale position. (Binder)
Dark illusion magic attack enhanced by Thanatos scale position. (Binder)

Dark magic attack against single target that generates Thanatos and moves the scale one step toward Thanatos. If the scale is at or beyond Thanatos 3/4 when this ability resolves, deals corrupt damage to all enemies and snaps the scale to Balanced. Does not affect pool values on snap. (Binder)
Light corrupt magic attack enhanced by Eros scale position. (Binder)

Light magic attack against single target that generates Eros and moves the scale one step toward Eros. If the scale is at or beyond Eros 3/4 when this ability resolves, raises and heals all allies and snaps the scale to Balanced. Does not affect pool values on snap. (Binder)
Deals dark damage to all enemies. Grants the Binder dark retaliation and dark add to all attacks for the rest of battle. Requires max Thanatos. Does not change scale position. (Binder)
Raises one ally to 1 health. Consumes Eros resource. Does not require Eros scale position. (Binder)
Heals target. Any overheal is applied as a damage shield. (Binder)
Magic fire attack that enhances own damage if Eros-aligned and lowers target defense if Thanatos-aligned. Enhanced by alignment. (Binder)
Move: Increases companion damage. Bonus scales with current Thanatos scale position. (Binder)
Increases companion defense. Bonus scales with current Eros scale position. (Binder)
Generates mana, Eros, and Thanatos. Requires Balanced scale position. Does not change scale position. (Binder)

Magic attack against the last enemy to attack the Binder's companion. Targets the attacker automatically. Available on the turn after the companion is attacked. Untyped damage, no alignment interaction. (Binder)
Compels target to attack the Binder's companion. (Binder)

Grants the companion a damage shield that refreshes at the start of the Binder's turn. Shield value scales with current Eros scale position. Reserves mana. Requires Eros scale position at 1/2 or greater. Permanent until deactivated. (Binder)
Grants the mana surge condition to any target. (Binder)
Heals the Binder. Any overheal is transferred to the companion as healing. (Binder)
The next creature summoned is generated as if it were one tier higher. No alignment interaction. (Binder)

The companion's attacks have a chance to proc damage weakness on the target. Weakness strength scales with current Thanatos scale position. Reserves mana. Requires Thanatos scale position at 1/2 or greater. Permanent until deactivated. (Binder)
Minor: Moves the scale one position toward Eros. If the scale ends on the Eros side, also generates Eros resource. (Binder)
Moves the scale one position toward Thanatos. If the scale ends on the Thanatos side, also generates Thanatos resource. (Binder)

Enhances light and dark power until the Binder's next turn. At Balanced: +5% to both. At each Eros or Thanatos position, enhances only the active alignment: 1/4 = +7.5%, 1/2 = +10%, 3/4 = +12.5%, Full = +15%. (Binder)

Enhances light and dark resistance until the Binder's next turn. At Balanced: +5% to both. At each Eros or Thanatos position, enhances only the active alignment: 1/4 = +7.5%, 1/2 = +10%, 3/4 = +12.5%, Full = +15%. (Binder)
Prepared reaction. Heals the companion in response to it taking damage. (Binder)
Heals the companion at the cost of the Binder's own health. (Binder)

Requires Eros scale position of 1/2 or greater. Reduces the scale by two positions and consumes Eros resource. Can later be activated to restore the same amount of Eros resource and move the scale back up by two positions. (Binder)

Requires Thanatos scale position of 1/2 or greater. Reduces the scale by two positions and consumes Thanatos resource. Can later be activated to restore the same amount of Thanatos resource and move the scale back up by two positions. (Binder)

classSkills: Alignment Trigger, Eros, Heal Self and Regen
Alignment Trigger, Eros, Barrier and Enduring

capstone.name: Preemptive Summon:  The first summon ability the Binder uses in battle has reduced mana cost and cast time.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.description: Divinity-fueled support and elemental offense. Wisdom-focused healer who generates a resource by helping allies and spends it on fixed-cost elemental control attacks or all-in light bursts, with resurrection and defensive tools that can reverse lost battles outright.

weapon.name: Mace and Shield
weapon.effect: reduced mana cost for healing abilities

Major: Consumes divinity to attack one target with a light magic attack (Cleric)
Afflicts one target with a light hex (Cleric)
Target one enemy with a light magic attack (Cleric)
Consumes divinity to attack all enemies with a light magic attack (Cleric)
Illuminate all enemies and lower light resistance (Cleric)
Purges all allies, generates divinity for each affliction healed (Cleric)
Target one enemy with a light melee attack (Cleric)
Raise all allies back to life (Cleric)
Consumes two divinity to deal fire damage and minimize next attack of column (Cleric)
Consumes three divinity to deal water damage and incapacitate enemy row for a period (Cleric)
Consumes one divinity to deal earth damage and stun enemy (Cleric)
Consumes four divinity to deal wind damage and delay all enemies (Cleric)
Move: Grants an ally damage shield, generates divinity (Cleric)
Heal ally with lowest health at beginning of next turn (Cleric)
Heal all allies at beginning of next turn (Cleric)
Consume one divinity to grant ally damage shield. Gain divinity when this damage shield is destroyed (Cleric)
Consume a divinity to ignore critical hits until next turn (Cleric)
Enhance all allies defense based on divinity (Cleric)
Minor: Increases ally damage.  At high levels, also increases critical damage (Cleric)
Cause next heal to have greater effect (Cleric)
Enhances the healing power of an ally for their next turn (Cleric)
Prepared ability that grants target immunity to death effects until the cleric’s next turn (Cleric)
Spend one divinity to gain mana (Cleric)
Enhance dark and corruption resistance.  Cannot be suffering from corruption (Cleric)
Grants allies mana on use.  At high levels, also prevents mana damage (Cleric)
Raises cleric’s affliction resistance until next turn (Cleric)

capstone.name: Enduring Grace: Heals incur a reduced vitality penalty, making subsequent heals more effective.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.description: Expertise-gated melee control and damage. Strength-focused brawler who builds a combat resource through stance-dependent actions, unlocking progressively stronger abilities as expertise accumulates, and forcing enemies to attack her through compel abilities that her passives and capstone then punish.

weapon.name: Axe and Shield
weapon.effect: increased damage versus enemies targeting the fighter

Major: Melee attack with increased damage and lower accuracy. (Fighter)
Melee attack with increased damage requiring 15 expertise. (Fighter)
Melee attack that causes flanked status to the target. (Fighter)
Melee attack with increased accuracy that delays user. (Fighter)
Melee attack with the shattering modification. (Fighter)
Melee attack that consumes 10 expertise and gains increased critical damage based on expertise. Consumes no expertise on a miss. (Fighter)
Unblockable melee attack (can still be parried and dodged). (Fighter)
Melee attack that causes defense weakness in the target. (Fighter)
Melee attack that lowers active defenses (block, dodge, parry) for a period. Requires 50 expertise, costs 20. (Fighter)
Melee attack with increased damage requiring 45 expertise. (Fighter)
Melee attack with increased damage requiring 75 expertise. (Fighter)
Melee attack that allows fighter to intercept the next attack against an ally. Costs 10 expertise. (Fighter)
Melee attack that consumes 20 expertise, healing self based on expertise. (Fighter)
Melee attack with high damage consuming 30 expertise. Has massive damage, with a chance to kill if it deals more than a percentage of the target's total health. (Fighter)
Melee attack requiring preparation for increased damage. (Fighter)
Melee attack that taunts target on critical. (Fighter)
Attack that stays prepared if it kills. (Fighter)
Melee attack that attacks an adjacent enemy on kill. (Fighter)
Melee attack targeting all enemies. Consumes 20 expertise. Deals increased damage based on total expertise at time of use. (Fighter)
Move: Compels all enemies to attack the fighter. (Fighter)
Enhances defense until the fighter's next turn. (Fighter)
Spend expertise on the next attack to turn a miss into a hit. (Fighter)
Purges a bleed effect and provides a weak heal. Requires bleeding. (Fighter)
Spend expertise on the next attack to turn it into a critical hit. (Fighter)
Spend expertise on the next attack to turn a glancing blow into a regular hit. (Fighter)
Taunts a single enemy with a taunt that lasts for two attacks. (Fighter)
Enhances damage of the target. Requires expertise. (Fighter)
Enhances defense of the target. Requires expertise. (Fighter)
Attacks the next enemy in melee range who makes a ranged attack. (Fighter)
Minor: Stance providing increased damage. Fighter generates expertise through dealing damage. (Fighter)
Stance providing increased defense. Fighter generates expertise through taking damage. (Fighter)
Enhances the damage of an ally for their next turn. (Fighter)
Stance that increases backbiting value. Fighter generates expertise through backbiting abilities. Advanced: bonus damage while endangered. (Fighter)
Compels a single target to attack the user. (Fighter)
Follows a dual-wield attack. Increases parry chance. (Fighter)
When using a large weapon and possessing 5 momentum, grants a small shatter effect to the next attack. (Fighter)
Enhances unit's parry until its next turn. (Fighter)
Prepared reaction. When an ally becomes endangered, provokes an enemy and generates expertise. Minor action. (Fighter)
Next block blocks an increased amount. (Fighter)
Refreshes all expert enchantments on all targets, updating values to the new expertise level if higher than original. (Fighter)

capstone.name: Compelled Dedication:  The fighter has improved damage versus any enemy that she has compelled.

knight.name: Knight
knight.description: Defensive bonding and companion protection. Strength-focused tank who selects one ally to guard, absorbs their damage, and builds a toolkit of threshold-triggered reactions, block and parry boosts, and attacks that simultaneously damage enemies and benefit the guarded ally.

Major: Melee attack that compels the target to attack the user with its next action.  Enhances unit defense for same period (Knight)
Melee attack that delays the target (Knight)
Melee attack that disrupts prepared abilities (Knight)
Melee attack that provides self with damage shield.  Also grants guarded damage shield (Knight)
Melee attack that lowers aim of target until the knight’s next turn (Knight)
Melee attack that provides self and guarded with barrier status (Knight)
Melee attacks, quickens guarded on hit (Knight)
Melee attack that lowers the damage of the target (Knight)
Melee attack that grants the guarded ally Improved Intercession, enhancing the Knight's protection when interceding for them and causing the Knight to take the next attack against them. (Knight)
Prepared melee attack from the Knight and a magic attack from the guarded ally. Generates mana for the guarded ally. (Knight)
Melee attack that requires the unit to have summoned a mount (Knight)
Melee attack that heals self after.  Requires being endangered (Knight)
Prepared melee attack from both the Knight and the guarded ally. If either attack misses, the other immediately makes a second attack. (Knight)
Prepared ability targeting an ally. If that ally is attacked before the Knight's next turn, the Knight intercedes and immediately counters the attacker. (Knight)
Melee attack that stuns target and enhances user’s block chance (Knight)
Melee attack that enhances user’s block chance and damage.  Requires shield (Knight)
Melee attack that can be used after the unit has taken a damage threshold (Knight)
Melee attack that enhances user’s elemental resist.  Also grants guarded element resist (Knight)
Attack requiring endangered.  Repeat attack on critical (Knight)
Move: Follows being healed.  Gain light damage add (Knight)
Melee attack with shield that requires threshold (Knight)
Guaranteed block against next attack that damages all.  Requires shield (Knight)
Applies Intercession to any ally. Quickens that ally. (Knight)
Melee attack against last enemy to target guarded ally. (Knight)
Threshold move ability. When the threshold is met, the Knight automatically intercedes on the next attack targeting any ally, reducing the damage of that intercepted attack. (Knight)
Purge mental afflictions from guarded ally and quicken for each purged (Knight)
Applies Intercession to guarded ally with enhanced block chance on the intercepted attack. Requires shield. (Knight)
Purges hex and provides minor heal.  Requires unit be hexed. (Knight)
Applies Intercession to the guarded ally and reduces damage the Knight takes from that Intercession. (Knight)
Minor: Enhances the defense of the target until its next turn (Knight)
The knight takes a portion of any damage dealt to the guarded (Knight)
Enhances the block chance of an ally (Knight)
Provides unit with damage shield.  Requires threshold (Knight)
Enhances unit’s block until its next turn (Knight)
Enhances units defense based on shield (Knight)
Gives knight chance to block for guarded (Knight)

capstone.name: Improved Intercessions
capstone.text: Whenever the knight intercedes on an attack against an ally, he takes less damage.

monk.name: Monk
monk.description: Form-switching melee fluidity. Dexterity-focused striker who transitions between seven chakra forms that each gate different abilities and open elemental bonuses, with attack outcomes that raise or lower the current form and demand adaptive sequencing every turn.

Major: Melee attack that deals extra elemental damage for each open chakra (Monk)
Melee attack that requires being in a form of monkey or above and lowers current form, has higher accuracy (Monk)
Melee attack that requires being in a form of monkey or below and raises current form, delays target (Monk)
Melee attack that requires form of dragon or above, raises form, has sudden modification (Monk)
Melee attack that requires of leopard or below, lowers form, raises counter damage (Monk)
Melee attack that provides focus to user (Monk)
Melee attack requiring crane form enhanced for each open chakra.  Sets form to snake on hit, and lowers form to mantis on miss (Monk)
Melee attack generating mana and healing based on open chakras and requiring dragon form.  Sets form to mantis on hit and lowers form to monkey on miss (Monk)
Melee attack that applies blunted to the target. (Monk)
Melee attack with sudden and unerring that requires momentum (Monk)
Melee attack that deals increased damage if focused (Monk)
Melee attack that applies brittle to the target. (Monk)
Prepared reaction melee attack. Delays the target based on the monk's current timer position. (Monk)
Multiple melee attacks based on number of open chakras requiring Leopard form.  Raises form to monkey if all hit and lowers form to tiger if any miss (Monk)
Melee attack requiring mantis form causing untyped bleed based on open chakras.  Raises form to crane on hit and lowers form to dragon on miss (Monk)
Melee attack requiring momentum. Stun duration scales with momentum value. (Monk)

Melee attack requiring monkey form with increased critical chance and critical damage and reduced accuracy based on number of open chakras.  Raises form to dragon on hit and lowers form to leopard on miss. (Monk)
Melee attack requiring snake form with penetration based on open chakras.  Raises form to tiger on hit and delays self on miss (Monk)
Melee attack requiring tiger form against column that quickens Monk based on open chakras.  Raises form to leopard on hit and lowers form to snake on miss (Monk)
Move: Grants the monk untyped retaliation until next turn.  Delays the monk. (Monk)
Stuns targets, must be last action of turn (Monk)
Closes all chakras to grant an elemental damage add based on current form at time of use. Scales with the number of chakras closed. (Monk)
Monk quickens on attack.  Activates on counters, as well.  Requires Crane form (Monk)
Next ranged attack against you targets a random enemy (Monk)
Creates a fire damage aura that lasts until the monk changes form. Requires dragon form. (Monk)
Reduces the duration of delay and stun effects currently on the monk. Requires snake form. (Monk)
Prepared reaction melee attack requiring momentum. (Monk)
The monk quickens on each hit for the remainder of the turn, with a greater effect on critical hits. Requires leopard form. (Monk)
Instead of countering next attack, the original attack targets a random enemy instead (Monk)
Minor: Close heart chakra to gain focus (Monk)
Enhances the affliction resistance of one ally (Monk)
